content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The High Court has advertised a total of 7 vacant positions of Research Assistants and for the preparation of a panel, to be utilized for filling up future or anticipated positions, valid for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a Domicile of Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir in terms of S.O. 166 dated 18.05.2020 issued by GAD, Government of Jammu and Kashmir or must be a resident of Union Territory of Ladakh for a period of not less than 15 years before the date of applying and is actually resident of the area. The candidate must have knowledge of Computer, including retrieval of desired information from various search engines/processes such as Manupatra, SCC Online, LexisNexis, Westlaw etc. The candidate must have absolute integrity, honesty and good moral character, for which he/she will submit a certificate of two responsible persons at the time of interview.

rows.qualification_required: Law Graduate (as on the date of appearing at interview) having a Bachelor's Degree in Law (including Integrated Degree Course in Law) from any School/College/University/Institute established by Law in India and recognized by the Bar Council of India for enrolment as an Advocate, possessing a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate at Law Graduation and should not have completed two years after enrolment as an Advocate. Candidates studying in the final year/last semester of three year Law Course/Five year Integrated Law Course are also eligible to apply subject to furnishing proof of acquiring the Law degree qualification with minimum 55% marks in aggregate at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Age Limit
content_sections.text: A candidate must not have attained the age of 33 years as on 1st January, 2026.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant(s), after engagement, shall not be entitled to any allowance(s) or perk(s) other than the honorarium.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Application Fee
content_sections.text: The prescribed fee is to be paid through online mode on the recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of Research Assistant shall be made in accordance with the selection process laid down in the guidelines as notified in the High Court Notification No. 578 dated 30.08.2016, as amended from time to time, vide Notification No. 1835/GS dated 14.03.2018, 807 of 2021/RG dated 26.08.2021 and 1287 of 2026 dated 07.08.2026, or any such other criteria as deemed necessary by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JK High Court Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Go to the official website of the High Court at www.jkhighcourt.nic.in . Access the recruitment portal link activated on the website. Register and fill out the online application form with the required details. Upload necessary documents and information as requested on the portal. Pay the prescribed online application fee of Rs. 250/-. Submit the application online on or before 13.10.2026. Take a printout of the submitted online application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: JK High Court Research Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Any wrong or incorrect information furnished by the candidate shall lead to the rejection of his/her candidature at any stage. The date and place of interview shall be notified separately through print media. No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for interview. On engagement, the candidate must take up the assignment of Research Assistant within the period specified in his/her order of engagement; no request for extension of time will be entertained. Research Assistants shall not be treated or deemed to be regular employees in the Services of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. Any Research Assistant intending to leave the assignment within a period of one year or extended period shall be required to give prior notice of one month with prior intimation to the Hon'ble Judge to whom attached.

faq.question: Q1. What is the JK High Court Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh for temporary engagement against 7 vacant positions of Research Assistants.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacant positions of Research Assistants available, along with a panel for future or anticipated positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications and online fee is 13.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JK High Court Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Law Graduates possessing a Bachelor's Degree in Law with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate and should not have completed two years after enrolment as an Advocate. Final year students may also apply subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: A candidate must not have attained the age of 33 years as on 1st January, 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The prescribed application fee is Rs. 250/- to be paid through online mode.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for JK High Court Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the recruitment portal available on the official website of the High Court at https://exams.jklhc.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary/honorarium for the post?
faq.answer: Selected Research Assistants will receive a consolidated amount of Rs. 40,000/- per month as honorarium.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of one year, extendable for a further period not exceeding one year, and Research Assistants are not regular employees.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The date and place of the interview will be notified separately through print media.
